title: UDP Receive
text: Receive UDP packets from UDP host, 3 outputs, {Data type} sets Data type of elements in UDP packets; {Local IP Port} sets the iP port on the receiving UDP host, {Remote IP address (0.0.0.0 for accepting all)} sets the iP address from which the block receives UDP packets, {Data size (N)} sets the number of data elements in each UDP packet, {Enable variable length} sets the variable length, {Maximum data size (N)} sets the maximum length of data, {Wait until data received} sets the wait until requested data is available and {Sample time} sets how often this block reads packets from the sending UDP. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: Data
ports.summary: UDP packets received from sending UDP host vector

ports.name: Status
ports.summary: Determine if requested data is received at the given time step scalar

params.name: Local IP Port
params.values: IP port on the receiving UDP host 25000 (default) | positive integer in the range [1,65535]

params.name: Remote IP address (0.0.0.0 for accepting all)
params.values: IP address from which the block receives UDP packets 192.1.168.10 (default) | 0.0.0.0

params.name: Data type
params.values: Data type of elements in UDP packets uint8 (default) | double | single | int8 | int16 | uint16 | int32 | uint32 | boolean

params.name: Data size (N)
params.values: Number of data elements in each UDP packet 1 (default)

params.name: Maximum data size (N)
params.values: Maximum length of data 1 (default) | positive integer

params.name: Wait until data received
params.values: Wait until requested data is available on (default) | off

params.name: Sample time
params.values: How often this block reads packets from the sending UDP host 0.1 (default)
